records.name: IFC 商場
records.coordinate_source: 政府 ALS；人工核對建築物／地址代表點，唔一定係入口；2026-10-23
notes: 只限家養貓狗，每位主人最多兩隻。
1樓可用唔超過1.5米牽繩落地；2至4樓必須留喺寵物車或袋內。
個別商戶規則另計；商場冇寵物車借用。
notes_en: Domestic cats and dogs only; up to two pets per owner.
On L1 pets may walk on a leash no longer than 1.5 metres. On L2–L4 pets must remain in a stroller or carrier.
Individual tenants have their own rules. The mall does not lend pet strollers.
